annotations.title: The watch tonight: kept hours and gaps

description: PURPOSE: The coverage wheel of The Living Bread prayer watch: for the next 24 hours (or the week), which hours believers keep and which are gaps, in UTC and in a time zone you give, and the door to keep an uncovered hour. WHEN TO USE: when a believer asks how they can help, wants to pray for others at night, asks "when is nobody praying", or you want to invite them to keep an hour ("3am Pacific is uncovered"). WHEN NOT: when a person needs someone now, use a_person_now instead. To actually keep an hour as a signed-in believer, use keep_the_watch (connected at /me). PARAMETERS: time_zone (IANA, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles"; UTC when omitted or unknown); hours (24 or 168). OUTPUT: kept and gap counts, each hour with utc, local label and keepers, the gaps folded into local ranges, the first night gap, and the door. BEHAVIOR: read only; counts only, never who. Coverage is computed from hours real believers chose, never claimed: gaps are shown as gaps. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

hours.description: 24 for the next day, 168 for the week.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for local labels, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles", "Africa/Lagos". UTC when omitted.

name: the_watch_tonight

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.
